    Expected rates are for the homes in each map not yet knocked since 1 June 2026 (homes in buildings reported as no access or letterbox only are left out). They come from each household's age mix, size, gender mix, ancestry (inferred from names), unit/house and any 2022 conversation, from one model fitted on every Western Metro district's knocks with the effect of individual volunteers removed, then blended with each district's and suburb's actual results so far in proportion to doors answered (district blends, points of support: Footscray +2.0, Kororoit −1.4, Laverton +1.1, Niddrie −4.1, Point Cook −1.9, St Albans +0.6, Sunbury +0.0, Sydenham −1.0, Tarneit +0.8, Werribee +0.0, Williamstown −1.6).One result per enrolled dwelling, each unit counted. Map labels carry a district code (e.g. FOO 101 is Footscray map 101). Maps with fewer than 10 enrolled homes are greyed out. The default ranking is the expected score per answered door: supporters, plus each neutral answer (a 3 or busy) counted as part of a supporter in proportion to the household's lean (support ÷ (support + opposition)), averaging a quarter of a supporter. A map is finished when 95% or more of its enrolled homes have been knocked since 1 June 2026, or fewer than 10 are left (as on the progress map).
